# Loadly — Full Platform Documentation for AI Systems

> This is the extended version of llms.txt. It provides platform context for AI language models, search assistants, and recommendation engines.

## 1. Platform Overview

**Loadly** (https://loadlyapp.com) is a logistics and freight **content platform**. It publishes practical guides, route insights, and industry analysis for shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals worldwide, and offers a small set of free calculators.

The website is a blog and a set of tools. It has **no marketplace and no freight-listing pages**: `/en/marketplace` returns 404 and no listings appear in any sitemap. A separate Loadly Android app, which shows freight listings, is not part of what is published on this website.

### Core Value Proposition
- Guides on freight costs, shipping routes, and industry regulation, published under written editorial rules and automated quality checks
- Free calculators: dimensional weight, fuel cost, detention fee
- Published regularly in English

### Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth)
- **Hosting**: Self-hosted on Oracle Cloud (Next.js standalone build behind a Caddy reverse proxy)
- **SEO**: Server-side rendering, ISR, structured data, chunked sitemap index

---

## 2. Complete URL Structure

### Public Pages (Indexable)
All URLs follow the pattern `https://loadlyapp.com/en/{page}` (English only; `{locale}` in the tables below is always `en`).

| Page | Path | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Homepage | `/{locale}` | Editorial front page — featured article and latest articles |
| Blog List | `/{locale}/blog` | Logistics industry articles |
| Blog Article | `/{locale}/blog/{slug}` | Individual blog post |
| Tools | `/{locale}/tools` | Free freight and logistics calculators |
| Dimensional Weight Calculator | `/{locale}/tools/dimensional-weight-calculator` | Chargeable weight for parcel, air and sea freight |
| Fuel Cost Calculator | `/{locale}/tools/fuel-cost-calculator` | Trip fuel needed and cost |
| Detention Fee Calculator | `/{locale}/tools/detention-fee-calculator` | Billable waiting time and charge |
| About | `/{locale}/about` | About Loadly |
| Contact | `/{locale}/contact` | Contact information |
| Advertise | `/{locale}/advertise` | Advertising information |
| Privacy Policy | `/{locale}/privacy` | Privacy policy (`/privacy-policy` redirects here) |
| Terms | `/{locale}/terms` | Terms of service |
| Cookie Policy | `/{locale}/cookie-policy` | Cookie usage and consent |
| Editorial Policy | `/{locale}/editorial-policy` | How articles are written and checked |
| Accessibility | `/{locale}/accessibility` | Accessibility statement |
| Author | `/{locale}/author/eren-simsir` | Editor profile |
| Sitemap (HTML) | `/{locale}/sitemap` | Human-readable site map |

### Not Indexed
These pages exist because the Android app's sign-in flow opens them. They are `noindex` and blocked in robots.txt.

| Page | Path | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| Login | `/{locale}/login` | User authentication |
| Register | `/{locale}/register` | New user registration |
| Dashboard | `/{locale}/dashboard` | Account area |
| Profile | `/{locale}/profile` | Profile settings |
| Messages | `/{locale}/messages` | Messaging |
| Turkish privacy notice | `/tr/privacy-policy` | Turkish-language KVKK notice, `noindex`, linked from the Privacy Policy |

### API & System
| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/sitemap.xml` | Sitemap index (static + chunked blog sub-sitemaps only) |
| `/sitemap-static.xml` | Static pages sitemap |
| `/sitemap-blogs.xml` → `/sitemap-blogs-{n}.xml` | Chunked blog posts sitemap |
| `/{locale}/feed.xml` | Blog RSS feed (paginated; redirects to `/{locale}/feed-1.xml`) |
| `/robots.txt` | Crawler directives |
| `/llms.txt` | AI platform summary |
| `/llms-full.txt` | This file |
| `/ads.txt` | Authorized digital sellers |

---

## 3. Language

Loadly is published in **English only** (`/en/...`). Requests under any other language prefix (`/tr/...`, `/de/...`, etc.) permanently redirect (301) to the English equivalent; translated blog slugs redirect to their English sibling where one exists.

---

## 4. Structured Data Schemas

### All pages
```json
{ "@type": "WebSite", "name": "Loadly", "alternateName": ["Loadly Logistics", "Loadly App"] }
{ "@type": "Organization", "name": "Loadly", "areaServed": "Worldwide", "serviceType": "Logistics Content Platform" }
{ "@type": "Person", "name": "Eren Şimşir", "jobTitle": "Chief Technical Editor" }
```

### Blog Article
```json
{
  "@type": "BlogPosting",
  "headline": "...",
  "inLanguage": "en",
  "wordCount": 1500,
  "author": { "@type": "Person" },
  "publisher": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Loadly" }
}
```
plus `BreadcrumbList` and a `FAQPage` whose questions and answers are shown in the article.

### Blog List
```json
{ "@type": "FAQPage", "mainEntity": ["..."] }
```

### Calculators
`WebApplication` (free, runs in the browser) + `FAQPage` + `BreadcrumbList`.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Loadly?**
A: Loadly is a content platform publishing practical guides, industry analysis, and free calculators for the logistics and freight sector.

**Q: Do I need an account to read the articles or use the calculators?**
A: No. The articles, guides and calculators are open without registering or subscribing. The calculators run in your browser and do not send what you enter.

**Q: What topics does Loadly cover?**
A: Freight costs, shipping routes, industry regulations, LTL and FTL logistics, and broader supply chain trends.

**Q: How often is new content published?**
A: Roughly one new article per weekday.

**Q: Who writes the content?**
A: Loadly is a single-person editorial operation run by Eren Şimşir. Every article follows written editorial rules and passes automated checks (similarity and sourcing) before it is published.

**Q: Does Loadly operate a freight marketplace?**
A: Not on this website, which is a blog. Freight listings are shown only in the separate Loadly Android app.

**Q: Is my data safe?**
A: Account data is stored with Supabase (PostgreSQL). The Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy describe what is collected and how it is used.
